desc:
You work at a liminal place that shouldn't exist...

Endless yellow hallways. Buzzing fluorescent lights. Empty rooms that seem to stretch on forever. To escape, you'll need to complete mission objectives and survive the bacteria lurking within the Backrooms.

⭐ XP BONUSES ⭐
👥 Play with friends to earn an XP multiplier!
👍 Like & Favorite the game to receive an additional XP multiplier!

🖥️ PC CONTROLS 🖥️
🏃‍♂️ Sprint — Left Shift
🔫 Use Gadget — Left Mouse Button

🎮 CONSOLE CONTROLS 🎮
🏃‍♂️ Sprint — Left Trigger (L2/LT)
🔫 Use Gadget — Right Trigger (R2/RT)

⚠️ WARNING ⚠️
This game contains intense chase sequences, loud sounds, and suspenseful moments that may be frightening to some players!
